sents.t: To: All Employees From: Office Management Re: Printing
Starting next Monday, each employee will need an ID card to use the printers.
This change will help us reduce paper waste significantly.
Last month, more than 2,000 pages were left on the printers and never collected.
Most of them were copies of the same lunch menu.
If you have any questions, please contact the help desk at extension 204.
